name: valis-registration-codex
description: Trigger: (1) registration produces misaligned images, (2) investigating non-rigid vs rigid registration quality, (3) configuring VALIS parameters for CODEX tissue-on-slide data, (4) batch re-registration across multiple projects. CORRECTED: Earlier 'rigid-only' conclusion was caused by a parameter passing bug (params=init_kwargs not unpacked). Non-rigid with tuned smoothing is the correct approach.
